job.title: Graduate Surveyor
job.description:
Are you a recent graduate or nearing the end of your surveying studies?

We are seeking a motivated Graduate Surveyor to join a growing team in a permanent position. With a large number of projects underway and a strong pipeline, this role offers long-term stability, exceptional hands-on training, and rapid career progression.
In this role, you won't just be stuck doing one thing. You will gain invaluable exposure to civil and structural engineering infrastructure.
It will be a structured environment designed to build your confidence, offering a dynamic mix of field data collection and office-based data management.

Why Join Us?
  • Permanent full-time role with a predictable, lifestyle-friendly Monday – Friday roster
  • Exposure to working alongside experienced Senior Surveyors and Managers
  • Local residential option – perfect if you want to be home every night
  • Competitive graduate salary package
  • Access to modern surveying equipment and industry-leading software (GPS, Total Stations, 12d, etc.)
  • Supportive and collaborative team environment with clear career development paths
About the Role
Working alongside our Senior team, you will be given the tools and guidance to gradually take ownership of survey activities across multiple civil and structural engineering sites.
Key responsibilities include:
  • Assisting with precise construction and engineering set-out programs for civil and structural assets
  • Learning to manage your own workflow seamlessly between field data capture and office processing/reporting
  • Learning to review and validate accurate detail, feature, and topographic surveys
  • Contributing to detailed as-built surveys, volume calculations, and comprehensive reporting
  • Developing technical expertise on complex structural and civil infrastructure components
  • Gaining high proficiency in the accurate use and calibration of GNSS, total stations, and cutting-edge survey instruments
  • Maintaining strict survey accuracy, data quality assurance, and safety standards 
About You
We are looking for an enthusiastic, proactive individual who is eager to learn, ask questions, and eventually work independently both on-site and in the office.
You will ideally have:
  • A Degree or Advanced Diploma in Surveying (or currently completing your final year)
  • A strong interest in Engineering, Civil, and Structural surveying
  • A desire to develop autonomy and manage field-to-office deliverables efficiently
  • Basic exposure to or a keen willingness to learn modern surveying instruments and processing software (such as 12d, Civil3D, Trimble, or Leica)
  • Strong attention to detail and a commitment to high-quality data
  • Excellent organizational, problem-solving, and communication skills
  • A current, valid Australian driver’s licence
For any further questions please reach out to Ashah Miller on 0405 611 596 or email on ashahm@roblawmax.com.au

job.title: Senior Surveyor
job.description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Surveyor to join a growing surveying team in a permanent position.
With a large number of projects underway and a strong pipeline this role offers long-term stability, genuine autonomy, and excellent career progression.

In this role, you will apply your expertise across major engineering infrastructure. This position offers a highly desirable balance between independent fieldwork and office-based data management all within a standard weekday schedule.

Why Join Us?
  • Permanent full-time role with a predictable Monday – Friday roster
  • Local residential option – perfect if you want to be home every night
  • Competitive salary package tailored to your experience
  • Access to modern surveying equipment and industry-leading software
  • Supportive and collaborative team environment with clear career development paths
About the Role
As a Senior Surveyor, you will work autonomously to execute and manage high-level survey activities across multiple civil and structural engineering sites.
Key responsibilities include:
  • Conducting precise construction and engineering set-out programs for civil and structural assets
  • Managing your workflow seamlessly between field data capture and office processing/reporting
  • Reviewing and validating highly accurate detail, feature, and topographic surveys
  • Executing detailed as-built surveys, volume calculations, and comprehensive reporting
  • Ensuring the accurate use and calibration of GNSS, total stations, and cutting-edge survey instruments
  • Maintaining strict survey accuracy, data quality assurance, and safety standards
  • Liaising directly with clients, project managers, and internal engineering teams
About You
We are looking for a self-motivated, technically proficient surveyor who thrives when working independently both on-site and in the office.
You will ideally have:
  • 5+ years of experience in an Engineering or Civil Surveying role (experience with structural concrete/steel set-outs is highly desirable)
  • Proven capability to work autonomously and manage field-to-office deliverables efficiently
  • High proficiency with modern surveying instruments and processing software (such as 12d, Civil3D, Trimble, or Leica)
  • Strong attention to detail and a steadfast commitment to high-quality data
  • Excellent organizational, problem-solving, and communication skills
  • A current, valid Australian driver’s licence

For any further questions please reach out to Ashah Miller on 0405 611 596 or email on ashahm@roblawmax.com.au

job.title: Manager - Kit Homes Division
job.description:
Location: Bulolo, Morobe Province, Papua New Guinea

An exciting opportunity exists for an experienced Manager – Kit Homes Division to lead the prefabrication and transportable building division of a well-established engineered wood products manufacturer. Based in Bulolo, you’ll oversee the production of transportable buildings, prefabricated kits, bridge decks, and other timber-based construction solutions.

This leadership role is responsible for managing a team of 60 and ensuring consistent, high-quality output across all projects.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Lead and manage the Kit Division team to deliver high-quality, timely outcomes.
  • Interpret technical drawings, specifications, and Bills of Quantities.
  • Oversee the manufacture of kit-set and transportable products.
  • Manage stock control, materials, and logistics for completed items.
  • Operate and supervise the use of Docking Saws, Double End Tenoners, Scarfing Equipment, and RF Presses.
  • Maintain a safe and efficient work environment aligned with company procedures.
  • Mentor and support workshop staff, including tradespeople and apprentices.
What You’ll Bring:
  • Certificate III in Carpentry and Joinery (or equivalent) from a recognised institution.
  • At least 5 years’ experience in a Carpentry/Joinery Foreman or similar leadership role.
  • Strong team leadership and workshop management skills.
  • Proficiency in reading complex drawings and managing multiple projects.
  • Solid knowledge of woodworking equipment and manufacturing processes.
  • Experience in quality control and driving team performance.
Key Challenges:
  • Developing a motivated, quality-focused workshop culture.
  • Managing stock flow and minimising material waste.
  • Meeting tight internal deadlines while balancing multiple priorities.
  • Strengthening cross-departmental communication and collaboration.
Why Apply?
This is a unique opportunity to step into a pivotal leadership role within a large-scale manufacturing environment. You'll play a key part in shaping the future of prefabricated construction in Papua New Guinea, supported by a skilled and dedicated team.
 
Ready to lead from the front?
Submit your CV and a cover letter outlining your relevant experience to: adamg@roblawmax.com.au
